text_en: There was a man in the hill country of Ephraim whose name was Micah.
text_cn: 厄弗辣因山地有一个人，名叫米加，

text_en: He said to his mother, “The eleven hundred pieces of silver that were taken from you, about which you uttered a curse, and even spoke it in my hearing, —that silver is in my possession; I took it; but now I will return it to you. ” And his mother said, “May my son be blessed by the Lord ! ”
text_cn: 他对自己的母亲说：“有人拿去你那一千一百银钱，对这事你曾起过誓，我也亲自听见你说：我要亲手把这项银钱奉献给上主，为我儿做一尊神像。看，银钱在这里，是我拿了；如今还给你！”

text_en: Then he returned the eleven hundred pieces of silver to his mother; and his mother said, “I consecrate the silver to the Lord from my hand for my son, to make an idol of cast metal. ”
text_cn: 他的母亲就说：“愿我儿蒙上主祝福！”于是米加就把一千一百银钱还给他的母亲。

text_en: So when he returned the money to his mother, his mother took two hundred pieces of silver, and gave it to the silversmith, who made it into an idol of cast metal; and it was in the house of Micah.
text_cn: 当他把银钱还给他的母亲以后，他的母亲便拿出两百银子给了银匠，请他制造一尊神像，安放在米加的家里。

text_en: This man Micah had a shrine, and he made an ephod and teraphim, and installed one of his sons, who became his priest.
text_cn: 于是米加为这尊神像盖了一座神庙，又做了“厄弗得”和“忒（tè）辣芬”，委派自己的一个儿子充任司祭。

text_en: In those days there was no king in Israel; all the people did what was right in their own eyes.
text_cn: 当时在以色列没有君王，各人任意行事。

text_en: Now there was a young man of Bethlehem in Judah, of the clan of Judah. He was a Levite residing there.
text_cn: 当时有一个少年，他是个肋未人，从犹大白冷，即从犹大支派来到那里作客。

text_en: This man left the town of Bethlehem in Judah, to live wherever he could find a place. He came to the house of Micah in the hill country of Ephraim to carry on his work.
text_cn: 这人离开犹大白冷，想找一个可寄居的地方；当他旅行的时候，来到厄弗辣因山地，米加的家旁，

text_en: Micah said to him, “From where do you come? ” He replied, “I am a Levite of Bethlehem in Judah, and I am going to live wherever I can find a place. ”
text_cn: 米加问他说：“你从哪里来？”他回答说：“我是个肋未人，由犹大白冷来，想找一个可寄居的地方。”

text_en: Then Micah said to him, “Stay with me, and be to me a father and a priest, and I will give you ten pieces of silver a year, a set of clothes, and your living. ”
text_cn: 米加就对他说：“你住在我这里吧！作我的师傅和司祭，我每年给你十块银钱，还照管你的吃穿。”米加挽留那肋未人，

text_en: The Levite agreed to stay with the man; and the young man became to him like one of his sons.
text_cn: 他遂同意住在米加那里，他看待这少年好似自己的儿子。

text_en: So Micah installed the Levite, and the young man became his priest, and was in the house of Micah.
text_cn: 米加又委任了这肋未人，这人遂作了他的司祭，住在米加家中。

text_en: Then Micah said, “Now I know that the Lord will prosper me, because the Levite has become my priest. ”
text_cn: 于是米加说：“如今我知道上主必施恩予我，因为有位肋未人作了我的司祭。”
